title: Five supervisors, one district for this drive
text: Cholame, Shandon and Paso Robles all lie in District 1, one of San Luis Obispo County's five supervisor districts. Each district elects one member of the Board of Supervisors, for overlapping four-year terms. In 2022 the county government spent about 827 million dollars and had about 2,800 full-time employees. Property taxes brought in about 230 million dollars that year.

s1.title: About the County
s1.quote: A five-member Board of Supervisors serves as the County’s legislative body, setting policies and priorities to best serve the needs of the community. Supervisors are elected by districts of approximately equal population to overlapping four-year terms. ... District 1 - Adelaide, Cholame, Lake Nacimiento, Oak Shores, Paso Robles, San Miguel, Shandon, Templeton (portion), Whitley Gardens
